howto.name: Upload an MKV file
howto.text: Drop an .mkv file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools re-encodes via FFmpeg
howto.text: The video is re-encoded as VP9, which browsers play natively and MKV never could.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Run the conversion. The result is VP9 WebM — open, royalty-free and suited to HTML5 video where MKV has no browser support at all.

faq.a: Yes, fully. The video is always re-encoded as VP9 at about 1 Mbit/s and the audio as Opus, even when the MKV already holds VP8, VP9, Vorbis or Opus.
